John Support

Ask product questions, work with files, and make informed changes with John by your side.

On this page

Start with a question

  1. 1Select John Support in the sidebar. Start a New chat or return to a conversation in the left rail.
  2. 2Explain what you want to do and where you are in the app. Include the customer or setting name when relevant.
  3. 3Send your question. Open the Based on references in the answer to read the guide excerpts behind it.

Conversations belong to the current workspace. Use the conversation menu to rename or archive a session so you can find it later. You can write to John in your preferred language.

Ask John to make a change

John can inspect settings and make supported changes on your instruction. Be specific: “Set my auto-reply delay to quick” is a change request. “Explain the reply delay options” asks for information.

Your instructions can take effect immediately

A clear change request can be applied straight away. John asks for clarification when needed and may direct you to an app screen for a required step. Your own permissions still apply.

Check receipts and Undo

  1. 1Read each change receipt to see what changed, which records were affected, and whether the action completed or failed.
  2. 2Use Undo when the receipt offers it, then check the resulting status. Some actions are permanent and have no Undo.
  3. 3If an automation has already started, open it to inspect its run and pause future runs if needed. Pausing does not recall messages already sent.

Add files and source material

Use the paperclip or drag a file into the chat, then explain what John should read or do with it. Supported documents include text-based PDFs, Word (.docx), plain text, Markdown, CSV and JSON. John reports when content could not be read or was only partly read.

An attachment stays with the conversation; it does not automatically become shared knowledge. Ask John to add it to Knowledge Base when you want customer-facing AI replies to use it. You can also provide a public HTTPS page for John to read.

Get help from the team

Choose Contact support in John Support, or use the support card John offers. Describe what happened, what you expected, and the affected workspace. Review and send the request; the team receives the conversation transcript and replies to your account email.

John cannot complete my request

Check the current workspace, your access and any receipt or on-screen error. Some connections require a setup wizard or scanning a QR code yourself. For unreadable documents, supply readable text or a text-based PDF. If the outcome of a change is unclear, inspect the affected record before asking John to repeat it.
